text: I've been on hold twice already tonight and the second time it just cut off, so I'm trying this instead and I'd appreciate someone actually reading it. I'm looking after my granddaughter Ellie, she's 4, while her parents are away till tomorrow. She's had a temperature since this morning and I took it again about twenty minutes ago and it says 39. Gave her the medicine at the right time, it's all written down. The reason I'm writing is she's got these little dark red dots coming up on her tummy and a couple on her arm, like someone's flicked a pen at her. My wife remembered you're meant to press a glass on them so we did that, a proper clear tumbler, and they don't go away. You can still see every one of them clear as day through the glass. I pressed hard. Did it twice to be sure. Now I don't want to be fobbed off with 'see how she goes' because I've already been seeing how she goes all evening. She's not floppy or sleepy or anything like that, I'll say that much, she's sat up on the settee watching her programme and nattering away to me about her cousin's birthday party, bright as a button. But those dots weren't there at teatime and I don't like the look of them. Somebody please get back to me tonight, not in the morning.
